newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil steady on flat premiums and futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil steady on flat premiums and futures.

text.p: NWE gas oil was steady on Monday as premiums held and futures showed no change.
May IPE gas oil was unchanged at $165.50 a tonne at 1200 GMT.
Activity on the physical spot market was moderate with barge business noticeably weak.
"No one is really up to much. We have refinery material (heating) at around May IPE +75 cents fob AR for first half May with second half at May IPE +$1," said one trader.
Diesel barges were assessed at around May IPE +$11 fob ARA.
Cargo premiums were steady with FOD unchanged at May IPE +$4.50 while diesel was strong around May IPE +$14.
